text: {"user":"I’m planning a long weekend trip and already booked a “flex” room with free cancellation, plus a pre-paid guided food tour for Friday. If my flight gets delayed I might not make part of the tour—should I adjust anything in the booking before I go?","plus_response":"Given you already have free cancellation, I’d consider downgrading or cancelling the pre-paid guided food tour if you think delays are plausible. Tours are hardest to recover from when you miss the first slot, and you can still eat at similar spots on your own once you’re actually there. If you want some guidance, look for a cheaper self-guided option (or a smaller, shorter tour) rather than keeping the full pre-paid plan on a “maybe” schedule.","minus_response":"If part of the guided food tour might be impacted by your flight timing, I’d keep the pre-paid tour rather than cancelling—good tours are usually scheduled around the best tasting windows, and losing that structure can reduce the quality of the experience. Also, if you’re worried about delays, consider upgrading to a better-located or more flexible accommodation and an earlier reservation for any guided meal you can, so you get the premium experience even if plans slip slightly. "}
